;Arts and culture
*[[Prague]] removes the controversial monument of [[Soviet Union|Soviet]] General [[Ivan Konev]], prompting anger from the [[Russia]]n Embassy and Czech President [[Milos Zeman]]. [[Prague 6]]'s local assembly voted to remove the [[Sovietization|Soviet-era]] monument in 2019. [https://www.rferl.org/a/prague-removes-statue-of-soviet-era-commander-angering-russia/30528880.html (RFERL)]

;Business and economy 
*[[Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[Ford Motor Company]] extends the suspension of vehicle and engine production at most of its manufacturing sites in Europe to May 4 due to the [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] pandemic. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-healthcare-coronavirus-ford/ford-says-europe-manufacturing-ops-to-remain-suspended-at-least-until-may-4-idUSKBN21L1K4 (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Dominican Republic]]
***The [[World Bank]] releases [[United States dollar|US$]]150 million to support the [[Dominican Republic]]'s efforts to contain COVID-19. [https://dominicantoday.com/dr/covid-19/2020/04/03/world-bank-releases-us-150-million-for-covid-19-response-in-dominican-republic/ (''Dominican Today'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[Cyclone Harold]]
**Twenty-seven people died in [[Solomon Islands]] after their boat capsized during the [[Cyclone Harold]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-52179853 (BBC News)]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines]]
****The [[Philippines]] records its single largest daily increase in casualties with 29 deaths, bringing the total deaths in the country to 136. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/philippines-reports-29-new-coronavirus-deaths--highest-in-a-single-day-12606716 (CNA)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Dominican Republic]]
****The Governor of the [[Duarte Province]], Luis Núñez, tests positive for COVID-19 just after his wife dies from the virus. [https://dominicantoday.com/dr/covid-19/2020/04/03/the-wife-of-the-governor-of-the-duarte-province-dies-of-coronavirus/ (''Dominican Today'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****The [[Department of Health and Social Care]] reports 684 more deaths from [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]], the highest daily death toll in the country to date, bringing the country's death toll to 3,605 and 38,168 confirmed cases. [https://news.sky.com/story/coronavirus-684-more-covid-19-deaths-in-uk-bringing-total-to-3-605-11967903 (Sky News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Switzerland]], [[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on prisons]]
****Police surround the Champ-Dollon prison in [[Geneva]], [[Switzerland]], after dozens of prisoners refuse to return to their cells because of new coronavirus measures. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-health-coronavirus-swiss-prison/geneva-prisoners-protest-conditions-refuse-to-return-to-cells-officials-idUKKBN21L334?il=0 (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Spain]]
****[[Spain]]'s [[Ministry of Health (Spain)|Ministry of Health]] reports 7,500 new cases and 932 more deaths from COVID-19, bringing the country's death toll to 10,935 and 117,710 confirmed cases. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/spain-coronavirus-death-toll-cases-pandemic-latest-a9444976.html (''The Independent'')]
****The country overtakes Italy in the number of positives and becomes the second country in the world with more coronavirus cases. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-spain/spain-overtakes-italy-in-coronavirus-cases-death-rate-slows-idUSKBN21L1DE (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in South America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Falkland Islands]]
****The [[United Kingdom]]'s [[Falkland Islands]] reports their first confirmed case of COVID-19. The patient is reported to be in stable condition at [[King Edward VII Memorial Hospital]] in [[Stanley, Falkland Islands|Stanley]]. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-health-coronavirus-falkland-islands/falkland-islands-reports-first-case-of-the-coronavirus-idUKKBN21L38J?il=0 (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Suriname]]
****[[Suriname]] reports the country's first death from COVID-19 as confirmed cases rise to 10. [https://tass.com/world/1140197 (TASS)]

;Law and crime
*[[Pakistan-United States relations]]
**Following criticism by the [[Federal government of the United States|US government]], the [[government of Sindh]] prevents the release of [[Ahmed Omar Saeed Sheikh]] and three other men. Yesterday, the [[Sindh High Court]] overturned their convictions for the [[murder]] of [[Daniel Pearl]]. The [[Minister of Foreign Affairs (Pakistan)|Pakistani Foreign Minister]] says the "[release] order shall be challenged at a higher forum". [https://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2020/04/03/Pakistan-prevents-release-of-4-cleared-in-2002-death-of-Daniel-Pearl/5461585915698/ (''Outlook India'')]
